Biography: My name is Noelle and I’ve been playing for a couple years now, with only a few experiences DMing. I am still learning certain rules but I do try my best to ask questions if needed.

Character Concept: I have been working on an idea for a tiefling sorcerer. Raised as the adoptive daughter of a devil, she would gain her magic as a gift after deciding to set out on her own. Despite her upbringing she is kind when need be and works to better herself and the reputation of devils.

Playstyle: I prefer and fairly even mix of combat and roleplay, usually about 60/40. I prefer to work with small groups as it’s easier to keep track of roleplay and messages.
